scoring_justification: Agent's line lengths can be recomputed from raw geometric parameters (d1,d2,θ',node_coords) using the paper's Appendix I formulas, and the final quantities are compared to the paper-reported gold values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported dislocation line length per unit area for the Cu/Cr Nishiyama-Wasserman (111) network and two-dislocation description
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text conclusion step 7 and Fig.6 caption: 'the dislocation line length per unit interface area from 9.5×10⁻¹ nm⁻¹ to 7.7×10⁻¹ nm⁻¹'
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the published paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported by the authors for the specific system and orientation; a correct re‑implementation should produce values very close to them.

outputs.description: Dislocation line length per unit area for two-dislocation description and three-dislocation network, plus geometric parameters. The hidden checker compares these values to the paper's reported results with an absolute tolerance and verifies theta_prime > 60°.

steps.description: Validates geometry and compares line lengths to paper gold
